newsitem.title: UK: Travis Perkins falls on press comment.
newsitem.headline: Travis Perkins falls on press comment.

text.p: Shares in Travis Perkins Plc, Britain's third largest builders' merchant, extended Monday's losses on Tuesday after some UK newspapers warned they could hit profit-taking.
The stock was 14 pence lower at 494-3/4p by 1040 GMT, having touched an intra-day low of 478 earlier.
Both the Financial Times and Daily Telegraph newspapers said the stock, at some 18-times prospective earnings, looked vulnerable to profit-taking.
Travis shares rose to a record 550p on March 17 having risen sharply over the past year.

The group on Monday announced a nine percent rise in 1996 pre-tax profits to 39.8 million stg and chairman Tony Travis said like-for-like sales were "modestly ahead" in the first two months of the current year.
